Shogunate Soldier A"Ah... aahhh..."
Shogunate Soldier B"Wh-what is this!? YEH KYA HAI—what the hell IS that!!"
Shogunate Soldier C"नमोऽमिताभाय बुद्धाय। नमोऽमिताभाय बुद्धाय।"
Shogunate Soldier D"C-castle... not there... Fudaraku Castle is not THERE..."
Shogunate Soldier E"Y-Your Excellency! Lieutenant General Ootori! Wh-wh-what is this... what is this happening...!?"
Shishiku"........................"
Shishiku(When old Nagakura suddenly contacted me—nahin, surely not. That was what I thought...)
Shishiku(...So they have done it. Here, on the very soil of Yamato—those white pigs!!)

en.html:
Kuniuji"Sh... Shishiku! An explanation. Give it!"
Shishiku"...Your Highness Kuniuji."
Kuniuji"You carried me off, took me out of the castle. And afterward—THIS BUSINESS!"
Kuniuji"That also is your doing!? Fudaraku... the shogunate... you mean to finish it all!!"
Shishiku"If that suspicion is truly in Your Highness’s mind, then my head is here. Have it struck off. Here and now."
Kuniuji"............"
Kuniuji"Then... this is..."
Shishiku"The work of the occupation forces."
Kuniuji"What!?"
Shishiku"A new weapon, called the Forged Bomb, I am told. With it, they must have intended to sweep Rokuhara away and take this country."
Kuniuji"————"
Kuniuji"Th-then... it is already... We are..."
Shishiku"But that work they have failed to complete."
Kuniuji"What?"
Shishiku"Rokuhara’s lord, His Highness Shirou Kuniuji Ashikaga, is here. Here, before us."
Shishiku"Your general Shishiku stands here. The Hokoshu and the Stable Corps, the finest of Rokuhara’s million riders, are with us also."
Shishiku"Further, the Sasagawa army under my command remains intact. —Rokuhara is not dead!"
Kuniuji"..."
Shishiku"Your Highness! With you at our head, this Shishiku will return in force. Of that, be certain."
Shishiku"Therefore, I beg you! This temporary humiliation, bear it. Place yourself in my keeping!"
Kuniuji"...You are asking me to retreat to your domain."
Shishiku"Yes!"
Shishiku"For now—to Aizu!"

ja.html:
邦氏「し……獅子吼！ 　説明をせよ！」
獅子吼「……邦氏殿下」
邦氏「そなたは余を攫さらい、城より連れ出した。 　そして――この仕儀！」
邦氏「あれもそなたの仕業なのか!? 　普陀楽を……幕府を滅ぼさんとしてか!!」
獅子吼「真まこと、そのような疑念をお持ちならば。 　殿下、今この場にて、我が首を刎ねられよ」
邦氏「…………」
邦氏「ならば……これは……」
獅子吼「進駐軍どもの仕掛けし事にございます」
邦氏「何だと!?」
獅子吼「鍛造雷弾フォージド・ボムと申す新型兵器の由。 　奴等はこれにて六波羅を一掃し、この国を 奪わんと企てたのでありましょう」
邦氏「――――」
邦氏「で、では……最早。 　……我らは……」
獅子吼「しかし、奴等は仕損じました」
邦氏「なに？」
獅子吼「我ら六波羅の主。 　足利四郎邦氏殿下はここに御座おはします」
獅子吼「殿下の将、獅子吼はこれに在ります。 　六波羅百万騎が最精鋭、奉公衆並びに厩衆 も付き従っております」
獅子吼「更に我が麾下、篠川軍が健在でございます。 　――六波羅は滅びておりませぬ！」
邦氏「……」
獅子吼「殿下！ 　この獅子吼、必ずや御身を戴き、捲土重来 致しまする」
獅子吼「故に、どうか！ 　一時の恥辱を耐え忍び、我がもとに御身を 預けられませ！」
邦氏「……そなたの領国へ落ちよと申すのだな」
獅子吼「はッ！」
獅子吼「今は――会津へ！」
